reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text: I’ve had this app about five minutes and I was stupid to pay for it. I’ve never used a more difficult and frustrating app. You have no control at all and you cannot reset a fast if it’s logged wrong or starts at the incorrect time. Rip off!

reviews.title: Not impressed with the subscription push.
reviews.text: I had used this app for years without a subscription, but had a lapse of usage, so when I went to log back on, it wouldn’t even let me log in without signing up for a subscription. I don’t appreciate the fact that it now is mandatory, when I was perfectly fine with the free version. Will not be using again.

reviews.title: Long-standing glitches
reviews.text: This is an easy and straight forward fasting timer app but I’ve had this for years and have never been able to go back and edit a fasting entry (if I made a mistake on the time or something) without the app freezing and shutting down… it would be nice if the app actually let you edit fasting logs.

reviews.title: Everything you need to succeed in your fasting endeavors

reviews.title: Redo Food Tracking section
reviews.text: So far I like the app but they seriously need an overhaul on the food tracking section. There is no barcode scanner so I have manually enter in everything which is super annoying since all the options listed don’t match what’s on the box. Once the food tracking section gets better, I definitely will raise my stars.

reviews.title: Have to sign in every time
reviews.text:
I subscribed quarterly and paid my 20 dollars and am very unsatisfied that I have to sign in every time.  Also there is no place to edit start fast and end fast.   I usually do a 65 to 70 hour fast. And  I find this inadequate.

I plan to try to get my subscription back from apple. If these items are not addressed.

Maureen Fogel

reviews.title: Clean out the food calories
reviews.text: So many items have a zero for calories when that is impossible! If I used the list to fill my daily calorie intake, I could eat 2000 and not even know it.

reviews.title: Membership?
reviews.text: Used to be my favorite fasting app and free but now apparently you need subscription to use at all? So, a while ago after not using the app for about 2 weeks I wanted to get back on track, but accidentally I left it on a fast, didn’t know how to fix, so instead of trying to figure it out I thought I’d just delete the app and start over (I was being lazy, my bad) but when i redownload the app and filled out all the stuff I couldn’t get past the subscription page😭 idk if it’s glaringly obvious and I’m just blind BUT I CANNOT FIND IT. And so now I’ve just come to the conclusion that I have to get a subscription just to use the stupid app. Literally nothing pisses me off more. It makes me physically angry and annoyed. Help me 😭💀

The app only allows for monthly, billed quarterly at $19.99, or weekly billed at $6.99.

This should be resolved today!

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I use this app on a daily basis, and they just added a nutritional analysis feature, and I really enjoy reading it. However, I wish they would add some kind of feature where you could take a picture of the nutritional facts on the product that you are eating and it would input the macros for you. It would save tons of time, and I’ve seen other apps do it. Overall, I really enjoy using this app and it has been extremely helpful in reminding me to drink water, providing me with informational sources about intermittent fasting, and keeping me on track!! I’ve lost about 20 pounds!

reviews.title: Cash Grab
reviews.text: Another cash grab app. When you get done filling out your information and reading the steps it provides you a screen with a "subscription plan" no exit button no X to click out! Even tried closing the app and opening it back up and it was just still there waiting for me to click "Purchase" Lol 😂 I'll give it some credit though, before it took me to the subscription screen it gave me a nice estimate and calculated my bmi , how much water i should be drinking and how long it would take to get to my goal weight! It kinda tricks ya and then is like peekaboo! It gets ur eye and then ask for something in return! Funny 😆

reviews.title: HORRIBLE UX, no way of IPhone Login
reviews.text: I am paying a $19.99 subscription but there is no clear way for me to login through my iPhone based on the subscription that I am already paying for. It has no record of my phone number nor email address! I have deleted and downloaded the app multiple times and it continues to walk me through their invasive sign up and continues to requests that I pay an additional subscription under the new information they are tracking for me. I originally deleted the app because there was no way to UPDATE my weight or restart my fasting journey after stepping away for a while. I wanted all of the history deleted! Now I am signed up for a 3 month service paid through iPhone app, and I have no way of logging in to my account! I know they didn’t ask for my phone number or email when I originally signed up because they just ask you to pay!
